Name: Custom NPC Roronoa Zoro Items for Json Assets
Author: EmpressKimi
Description:
[b][size=4]This mod is only for if you have already downloaded [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6316]custom NPC Roronoa Zoro[/url][/size]
[/b]
I wanted my NPC Roronoa Zoro to have a custom weapon to use for NPC Adventures, and I ended up making a few more things for him.

You don't need [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7100]Custom NPC Roronoa Zoro - NPC Adventures[/url] to run this json asset mod, BUT if you have NPC Roronoa Zoro - NPC Adventures then this json asset mod is required.

This Json asset mod includes


[color=#6aa84f]3 Weapons: [You can buy these at Marlon's shop][/color]
[list]
[*]Sandai Kitetsu - Zoro's cursed katana from Logue Town. Finicky blade that is difficult to handle.
[*]Shusui - Black blade once wielded by the famous samurai Shimotsuki Ryuma.
[*]Wado Ichimonji - A special katana to Zoro, belongs to his dead childhood friend.
[/list]
[color=#3d85c6]1 recipe: [You can buy this at Gus][/color]
[list]
[*]Sea Kings Nigiri - Seafood nigiri dish from the legendary beasts of the sea.
[/list]      Love: Zoro
      Like: Willy, Linus, Gus, Elliot, Sebastian[color=#B45F06]

1 food item: [You can buy this at Pierres][/color]
[list]
[*]Sweet Chocolate - Made from the fruit of the Theobroma cacao, a tropical tree whose name means 'food of the gods' in Greek. Sweeter than normal chocolate. (No, the mod does not include cacao plant or seed.)
[/list]    Love: Jas, Vincent
    Like: Abigail, Caroline, Elliott, Emily, Haley, Jodi, Leah, Marnie, Maru, Penny, Robin
    Hate: Zoro

(Yes, I made chocolate because the official Roronoa Zoro wiki says he hates chocolate but vanilla Stardew Valley does not have chocolate. I made chocolate just so Zoro can hate it if you give it to him.)

[color=#f1c232]1 hat: [You can buy this at Hat Mouse][/color]
[list]
[*]Zoro's Bandana - The infamous bandana of Roronoa Zoro.
[/list]
___________________________________________________________

Future updates?:
[list]
[*]Maybe more One Piece themed items like Luffy's straw hat
[/list]
__________________________________________________________

Disclaimer:
I'm not an artist. All the sprites are my own horrible attempts at pixel art.
